scenario: Alex asks the agent for a simple morning reminder with no issues.

turns.text: Remind me to take out the trash at 7 AM tomorrow.
Got it, I'll remind you to take out the trash at 7 AM tomorrow.
Thanks!
You're welcome, have a good night.

expected.agent_should: Set and acknowledge a one-time reminder.

turns.text: How many eggs do I need for a dozen cupcakes?
duplicate webhook delivery of SM7e5ac20f96d843e1b82c06da4571af82
You'll need about 3 large eggs for a dozen cupcakes.
Perfect, thank you.

scenario: Jordan opts out of receiving messages after requesting a reminder.

turns.text: Remind me to water my plants on Friday.

STOP
carrier opt-out confirmation sent

Can you still remind me?

expected.agent_should: Process the opt-out, stop future outbound messages, and refrain from replying after the opt-out is confirmed.
must_not: send a reminder or follow-up after opt-out

carrier help response processed by connector
